checks.name: isolated client lists only the temporary CodeBudget registration
Claude Code health check connects to the CodeBudget MCP server

clientCommands: claude mcp add --scope local codebudget -- <node> <repository>/dist/cli.js mcp serve
limitations: Client health check only: the client starts the server, completes the MCP initialize handshake and reads its capabilities. Tool calls inside a model session, plugin hooks, usage exports and quality are not exercised.
The registration omits --root, so the server resolves the project from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or the working directory the client chose.
